It is context, not support for Brooks's assists.","kind":"injury","direction":"context","represented_in":"unknown"}]},{"candidate_id":"f6cb028438b9b299b209289c","status":"concern","assessment":{"verdict":"pass","reason":"The large model edge on the under likely comes from pre-promotion bench data. Brown appears to have moved into a starting playmaker role after Traore's injury, and the model does not adjust for teammate absences.","model_case":"The projection of 3.34 on 23.5 minutes sits just under 3.5. If Brown now starts and runs the offense, both his minutes and assist rate likely rise. A rolling sample mixing bench games would then understate him and inflate the under.","price_case":"At +165 the under needs about a three-in-eight hit rate. The plus-money price signals the book leans over. The large model-versus-market gap more plausibly reflects the role change than value; one book is not consensus.","context_case":"The sourced reporting points to an expanded role, which runs against the under. Raptors absences may also affect pace and game script, but that is unquantified.","blocking_checks":[]},"countercase":"Brown is a rookie with only a handful of starts. His minutes could stay moderate, or Brooklyn could share ball-handling, which would keep his assists near three. If his starter usage merely matches his recent average, the under at plus-money could hold up.","open_checks":["Check Brown's minutes and assists in the starts since Traore's injury.","Confirm Brooklyn's starting lineup and whether Brown keeps the lead guard role.","Check Alijah Martin's status and its effect on Toronto's rotation."],"evidence":[{"source_id":"ad1966844c18afca284b","excerpt":"Brown was given his first career start on Monday against the Timberwolves","interpretation":"If the start continues, Brown's role likely exceeds what a rolling sample built on bench games captures. That would bias the projection low and weaken the under.","kind":"deployment","direction":"concern","represented_in":"unknown"},{"source_id":"08e2025154be7563941e","excerpt":"Nolan Traore (right hamstring) will be re-evaluated in 8-10 weeks.","interpretation":"A long Traore absence implies sustained ball-handling opportunity for Brown. The model does not adjust for teammate absences.","kind":"injury","direction":"concern","represented_in":"neither"}]},{"candidate_id":"eca5c4798d26058012512671","status":"needs_information","assessment":{"verdict":"wait","reason":"The price sits above break-even on both the model and the one paired book, but Giannis's game-time status could materially change Portis's frontcourt minutes. The model does not account for that.","model_case":"The projection of 4.52 on 18.1 minutes essentially equals the line, with a median of 4. The case depends on the tail and is very sensitive to minutes. A few extra frontcourt minutes help, while a reduced role sinks it.","price_case":"At +150 the over needs roughly two-in-five. The model and the one other book are almost identical and modestly above that. This is a price-driven case, not a model disagreement, and whether 4.5 is the main line is unclear.","context_case":"Multiple frontcourt game-time decisions on both teams leave Portis's minutes and the rebounding competition unresolved.","blocking_checks":["Giannis Antetokounmpo's status: if he sits, Portis likely gains minutes and boards; if he plays, the over relies on Portis's usual bench workload alone.","Portis himself has no confirmed status, and the morning price comes before the game-day injury report."]},"countercase":"With a small minutes base, a quick blowout or a tight rotation cuts Portis's rebounding chances. If Drummond sits, the Knicks could play smaller and change the rebound pool. Bam Adebayo's heavy rebounding may absorb any extra boards created by Giannis's absence.","open_checks":["Confirm Giannis's and Wiggins's final statuses and Miami's starting lineup.","Check whether Drummond and Anunoby play for New York.","Reconfirm the +150 price after the injury news settles."],"evidence":[{"source_id":"7985b78581a24c640af3","excerpt":"Giannis Antetokounmpo (PF); Groin; Game Time Decision; updated Thu, Nov 26.","interpretation":"If Giannis sits, Portis's minutes and rebounding opportunities could rise beyond the model's 18-minute assumption. If Giannis plays, that upside disappears.","kind":"injury","direction":"context","represented_in":"unknown"}]}]}
